# craft-suite-api — Architecture

> Current documentation index generated from the exact MkDocs navigation.
> Capability and content-use claims are operator-scoped and provenance-bound.

## Architecture

- [Architecture](https://knuckles-team.github.io/craft-suite-api/architecture/) — The craft-suite-api package owns the eight reviewed external-system operations. Graph ingestion is unavailable until a scoped source mapping is implemented. The shared connector SDK owns reusable runtime contracts.
